text:
pagerbot: alert triggered — high gpu allocation churn in dedicated-prod (asia-south) at ~05:12 UTC. metric: gpu_alloc_fail_rate spike > threshold, auto-pager sent to #incidents and oncall.

sre_oncall_amy: I'm looking. Which nodepool and any immediate customer failures?

dana_ml_infra: nodes affected: ded-azs-03 and ded-azs-07. CUDA OOM traces on azs-07, allocator returning fragmented free list entries. Raised alarm at 05:13:02.

pagerbot: summary: error_rate 5xx up 6% for tenant corp-nova; tenant-specific failures detected. Severity P1.

alice_runtime: corp-nova saw increased 500 responses starting 05:13:20. They are on model:fastlarge-quant with batch=6 and kv_cache enabled.

ben_prodeng: tagging @customer-success-eli to prep customer note.

customer-success-eli: noted, standby to update customer. Please advise ETA on mitigation.

sre_oncall_amy: quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle batch_size for corp-nova to 1 at routing layer, 2) disable kv_cache.warmup on azs-07, 3) cordon + drain azs-07 if errors persist. Implementing 1+2 now.

alice_runtime: commands I'm executing now:
```
redwoodctl routing patch --tenant corp-nova --route /v1/completions --set batch_size=1
redwoodctl node-config set --node ded-azs-07 kv_cache.warmup=false
```

alice_runtime: routing change applied, warmup off on azs-07.

dana_ml_infra: kernel log snippets:
```
[05:13:46] cudaMalloc returned cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
[05:13:46] kv_cache.alloc(prefix=512) -> requested 512MB, largest_free_contiguous=64MB
[05:13:47] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 40321 (redwood-runtime)
```

ben_prodeng: I've cordoned azs-07 and draining pods now:
```
kubectl cordon ded-azs-07 && kubectl drain ded-azs-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

pagerbot: note: oncall handoff scheduled at 05:30 UTC to @sre_oncall_li. Please record handoff.

sre_oncall_amy: handoff checklist (fill in):
- Current: batch_size override active, kv warmup off on azs-07, azs-07 cordoned.
- Customer impact: corp-nova had ~6% 5xx spike, about 3% of their requests affected during peak. CS informed.
- Hypotheses: A) KV cache fragmentation leading to insufficient contiguous allocations, B) allocator tuning change in recent rollout (2026-03-10) reduced coalescing, C) mixed-tenant workload causing high churn.
- Artifacts: nvprof snapshots in paste (https://paste.redwood.internal/nvprof/def-azs-07), kernel logs in s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2061122333/kernel.log, runtime traces in /var/log/redwood/runtime/oom-2061122333.log
- Next actions: capture heapdump, run defrag simulation on staging, consider forcing model fallback for corp-nova.

dana_ml_infra: starting heapdump:
```
redwoodctl debug heapdump --node ded-azs-07 --out s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2061122333/heapdump.azs-07.bin
```

alice_runtime: small low-risk experiment applied to azs-03 (not azs-07): reduce kv prefetch and enable periodic eviction sweep. Config snippet applied:
```
kv_cache.prefetch_rate=0.15
kv_cache.evict_interval=25s
allocator.merge_threshold=enabled
```

ben_prodeng: after mitigation metrics: gpu_alloc_fail_rate dropped from 18/min -> 3/min over 6 minutes. corp-nova 5xxs down to 1.2%. Partial recovery but still monitoring.

sre_oncall_li: taking over. amy, anything critical to hand off besides todo list?

sre_oncall_amy: left pending: heapdump upload, check runtime flag compact_on_free (might be false), correlate per-tenant memory footprints from proxy logs.

sre_oncall_li: will verify compact_on_free and check commit diffs. Assigning infra-eng for allocator review.

dana_ml_infra: heapdump uploaded to s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2061122333/heapdump.azs-07.bin. Also extracted a quick allocation skyline: https://paste.redwood.internal/alloc/skyline-2061122333

alice_runtime: note: historical correlation — similar pattern in late-2025 when lazy KV warmup + medium batches created fragmentation on 40GB cards. Key difference now: mix of quantized and q2 variants causing different allocation chunk sizes.

ben_prodeng: brief timeline (UTC):
- 05:13:02 alert raised
- 05:13:20 first customer 500s observed (corp-nova)
- 05:13:47 kernel OOM kill
- 05:14:30 batch override + warmup disabled
- 05:16:05 model fallback queued
- 05:18:30 eviction sweep + prefetch throttle applied to azs-03
- 05:20:00 metrics show partial recovery

customer-success-eli: corp-nova updated at 05:25 with mitigation steps; monitoring for escalation.

sre_oncall_li: Hypothesis tracker (add evidence):
- Hypothesis A (fragmentation): evidence: alloc skyline shows many small free segments, heapdump shows scattered prefix allocations. Mitigation effect: eviction + throttle reduced allocation failures.
- Hypothesis B (allocator regression): evidence: need to grep commits around 2026-03-10 for coalescing/compact flags. Infra-eng to triage.
- Hypothesis C (tenant mixing): evidence: corp-nova traces show bursty long sequences during window; need to correlate with other tenants on same nodes.

infra-eng: I've pulled the commit diff for allocator: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/commit/e9f4b2 which toggled coalescing heuristics. Assigning owner for revert test if needed.

sre_oncall_li: follow-up mitigations if recurrence: 1) force smaller model variant for corp-nova (policy override), 2) enable allocator compaction (likely requires rolling restart), 3) reserve spill buffer on GPUs to reduce contiguous allocation failures.

ben_prodeng: will open a post-incident ticket: include reproducer, per-tenant seq tests, and allocator revert experiment.

sre_oncall_li: Handoff for next shift:
- Incident INC-2026-03-15-042B (allocated new suffix) — status: MONITORING, partial recovery.
- Keep batch override for corp-nova for 2 hours, then ramp cautiously.
- Owners: dana_ml_infra + alice_runtime + infra-eng for RCA.

pagerbot: oncall change: @sre_oncall_li now on duty. Incident remains active until RCA ticket created.

customer-success-eli: logged customer update at 05:27. Will escalate if customer reports regressions.

dana_ml_infra: next steps: run defrag experiment on staging nodes with synthetic long-seq load, collect allocation histograms hourly.

sre_oncall_li: thanks team. I'll kick off RCA draft and follow up with infra-eng for quick revert test. Post anything else here if you see regression.

alice_runtime: created short playbook note: /playbooks/kv-frag-short.md with quick commands for responders.

ben_prodeng: added postmortem checklist to ticket: reproduce, quantify customer impact, allocator fix, long-term mitigations (per-tenant reservation, test harness).

pagerbot: Incident state -> MONITORING. Incident record: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-03-15-042B
